# Nakwave

> Nakwave is an SEO and AI-automation studio founded by SEO expert and AI engineer Farhan Hyder — two crafts with equal weight. Search: search engine optimization that ranks brands on Google, plus answer engine optimization (AEO) that gets them cited by ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Claude. Automation: AI chatbots, WhatsApp automation, multi-agent (agentic) workflows and analytics dashboards that run the business processes that follow.

Key facts:
- Founded and led by Farhan Hyder, SEO expert and AI engineer. Contact: hyderfarhan96@gmail.com · +91 6361506839.
- Serves clients in India and worldwide. Languages: English, Hindi, Kannada.
- Free AI Visibility Audit delivered in 3 business days, no obligation, report yours to keep.
- Every engagement reports movement from the client's own Search Console and live AI-engine testing.
- Demonstration builds are labelled as demonstrations; industry statistics are cited as industry statistics.

## Services

- [All services](https://nakwave.services/services/): Two crafts — search (SEO, AEO, AI visibility audits) and automation (chatbots, agentic workflows, analytics).
- [Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)](https://nakwave.services/services/answer-engine-optimization.html): Structured data, answer-first rewrites, entity and E-E-A-T signals, AI crawl layer and monthly citation tracking so AI engines extract, trust and cite the brand.
- [AI Visibility Audit](https://nakwave.services/services/ai-visibility-audit.html): Free scored audit testing a brand across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Claude with real customer questions, benchmarked against named competitors.
- [SEO Services & Website Builds](https://nakwave.services/services/seo-services.html): Technical SEO, site architecture, on-page work and fast static builds engineered for Google and AI engines in one pass.
- [AI Chatbots & WhatsApp Automation](https://nakwave.services/services/ai-chatbots-whatsapp-automation.html): Bots trained on real catalogue and policy data on the official WhatsApp Business API, with qualification, booking and human handover.
- [Agentic AI Workflows](https://nakwave.services/services/agentic-workflows.html): Multi-agent systems that qualify leads, book meetings, update CRMs and report, with guardrails and human escalation.
- [Data Analytics & Dashboards](https://nakwave.services/services/analytics-dashboards.html): Cleaned data, live KPI dashboards, statistical anomaly alerts, forecasting and a computed-answer copilot.

## Guides

- [What Is AEO? Answer Engine Optimization Explained](https://nakwave.services/blog/what-is-aeo.html): Plain-English explanation of AEO, how it differs from SEO, and the five pillars of citable content.
- [How to Get Your Business Cited by ChatGPT](https://nakwave.services/blog/get-cited-by-chatgpt.html): Practical seven-step checklist — baseline, schema, answer-first rewrites, FAQs, citable claims, entity building, monthly tracking.
- [llms.txt: What It Is and Should You Have One](https://nakwave.services/blog/llms-txt-guide.html): Honest guide to the llms.txt standard, its adoption status, and why we ship it anyway.
- [AI Overviews & Zero-Click Search: The 2026 Data](https://nakwave.services/blog/zero-click-search-2026.html): 83% of AI-Overview searches end without a click and 5 in 6 citations come from outside the top 10 — what that means and how to respond.
- [Get Your Local Business Cited by ChatGPT & AI Search](https://nakwave.services/blog/local-business-ai-search.html): Local playbook — LocalBusiness schema, reviews, Google Business Profile, Yelp/Perplexity and entity consistency.
- [AI Agents Are the New Shoppers](https://nakwave.services/blog/ai-agents-agentic-search.html): How autonomous agents browse and buy, and how to be the option they choose.

## Work & proof

- [Aarohi Silks — an SEO rebuild, measured](https://nakwave.services/work/silk-rebuild.html): A demonstration rebuild taking a storefront from an AI-visibility score of 16 to 91, with all 20 detected bugs and their fixes listed.
- [InsightAI — a working BI product](https://nakwave.services/work/insightai.html): Live analytics engine with anomaly detection, trend-and-seasonality forecasting, RFM segmentation and a computed-answer copilot.
- [Meridian — an AI employee for luxury dealerships](https://nakwave.services/work/meridian.html): Interactive concept with real inventory NLU, depreciation-based trade valuation, finance maths and lead scoring. Labelled a concept, not a client deployment.
- [Sample AI Visibility Audit](https://nakwave.services/audit-sample.html): A real published audit scoring a live site 38/100 with evidence for every finding.
